## 12. The device gate refuses on one low reading, taken while a session starts

After the restart, the orchestrator could not launch the CL44 part: `device.py --gate` said 574 MB free (needs 950). Minutes later the same gate said 1960 MB free, one more fits. Nothing had ended; the new agy orchestrator, its board server, clerk and MCP were starting, and startup peaks above what they settle at (agy ~340 MB settled). This device has no swap, so the margin is right; one sample is not.

**Fix:** `gate()` (scripts/device.py) only refuses on memory if the shortage holds: re-read available RAM every ~3 s for up to ~30 s and pass as soon as one reading fits. The session-cap check stays immediate (a count, not a reading). The refusal says it waited and what the readings were. Callers (kit.py launch line, capacity --gate, mcp_stdio) need no change.

**Test:** a fake meminfo that reads low then high passes within the window; one that stays low is refused after the window, with the readings in the message; the cap refusal does not wait.
